# Carnegie Corporation of New York

> > A philanthropic foundation established by Andrew Carnegie supporting education, international peace, democracy, and African development through strategic grantmaking and fellowship programs.

Carnegie Corporation of New York carries forward Andrew Carnegie's legacy through major program areas including Education, International Peace and Security, Democracy, and Higher Education and Research in Africa. The foundation supports research, policy development, and institutional capacity-building through grants and the Andrew Carnegie Fellows program.

## Key Topics

- Andrew Carnegie Fellows
- Philanthropy and grantmaking
- Education reform and strategy
- African universities and development
- CODESRIA (Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa)
- Immigration and naturalization
- Democracy and civic engagement
- International peace and security
- Social sciences and humanities research
- Library development and access
- Russia and U.S. foreign policy
- Vartan Gregorian (former President)
- Gospel of Wealth
- Great Immigrants program
- Rural America demographics

## Program Strategy and Grantmaking

- [Education Program Strategy Overview](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/education-program-strategy-overview): Overview of Carnegie Corporation's Education Program strategic approach
- [Carnegie Corporation Board Approves 30 Grants Totaling $22,605,000](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/carnegie-corporation-new-york-board-approves-30-grants-totaling-22605000): Board approves 30 grants totaling $22.6M at December 2020 meeting
- [Grantees](https://www.carnegie.org/grants/grantees): Grantee resources, reporting requirements, and communications guidance
- [A Gospel of Giving](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/op-ed-dear-mr-carnegie): President Vartan Gregorian on Gospel of Wealth and charitable giving

## Africa Program and Development

- [Social Sciences Neglect Drives Inequality in Africa](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/social-sciences-neglect-drives-inequality-africa): CODESRIA report on social sciences & humanities vital to Africa development
- [New Library Opens in Cape Town](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/kuyasa-library): Kuyasa library opening in Cape Town marks new Africa program milestone
- [Democratizing and Preserving Knowledge](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/democratizing-and-preserving-knowledge): Digital preservation and library digitization efforts for cultural heritage

## Andrew Carnegie Fellows and Scholarship

- [An Apology for a Lynching in Georgia](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/margaret-burnham): Andrew Carnegie Fellow Margaret Burnham's restorative justice work
- [The Promise of Protectionism and the Appeal to Isolationism](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/christopher-nicols): Carnegie Fellow Christopher Nicols on US isolationism & internationalism
- [Where Is "Rural America," and What Does It Look Like?](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/kenneth-johnson): Carnegie Fellow Kenneth Johnson's demographic research defines rural America

## Immigration and Democracy

- [How America's Immigrant Source has Changed](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/how-americas-immigrant-source-has-changed): 59M immigrants since 1965: shifting sources from Germany to Mexico
- [Nominate a Great Immigrant Great American](https://www.carnegie.org/giga-nomination-form): Great Immigrants award program nomination form for naturalized citizens
- [Grantee Report Highlights the Myth of Rising Numbers of Undocumented Immigrants](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/grantee-report-highlights-myth-rising-numbers-undocumented-immigrants): Center for Migration Studies debunks myth of rising undocumented numbers
- [The Higher-Education Crisis Beneath a Civil War](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/higher-education-crisis-beneath-civil-war): Syrian students face education crisis amid immigration policy barriers

## International Peace and Security

- [Five Questions: Russia's Goals in Syria and Ukraine](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/five-questions-russias-goals-syria-and-ukraine): Expert Rajan Menon analyzes Russia's foreign policy in Syria & Ukraine
